payload.label: Board pack 2027
payload.reason: The board renamed its working papers.

note: No reason. A change to what administrators and offered members see is recorded with why it was made.
Nothing to change. A request that names no detail would be audited as a change that is none.
A description and its removal at once.
`removeDescription: false`. Only `true` means anything; a false one would be a request that changes nothing while looking as though it might.
An empty label. A room always has a name.
An empty description. Removing one is `removeDescription`; an empty string would display as a description that says nothing.
A repeated tag. Tags are a set.
A visibility. The tier is fixed for the life of the room; nothing here reaches the room itself.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
